```{julia}
th = 0.9
ls = 100
lrs = unique(st.learning_rate)
lr = lrs[1]
#lr = 0.00001
#lr = 0.00005
#lr = 0.000005
df_sel = subset(
    st, 
    :threshold => ByRow(==(th)),
    #:learning_rate => ByRow(==(lr))
    :lambda_sensitivity => ByRow(==(ls))
)
```

```{julia}
df_last = combine(groupby(df_sel, :param_dir)) do sdf
    sdf[argmax(sdf.time), :]
end
```

```{julia}
df_last.n_bees .= df_last.n_agents
```

```{julia}
#df_sel.any_ratio = df_sel.any_geq ./ df_sel.n_bees
#df_sel.exactly_ratio = df_sel.exactly_one_geq ./ df_sel.n_bees
#df_sel.unique_ratio = df_sel.unique_specialist ./ df_sel.n_bees
df_last.any_ratio = df_last.any_geq ./ df_last.n_bees
df_last.exactly_ratio = df_last.exactly_one_geq ./ df_last.n_bees
df_last.unique_ratio = df_last.unique_specialist ./ df_last.n_bees
```

```{julia}
agg = combine(
    groupby(df_last, [:interaction_rate, :dead_time]),
    :unique_ratio => mean => :unique_ratio_mean,
    :unique_ratio => std  => :unique_ratio_std,
    :exactly_ratio => mean => :exactly_ratio_mean,
    :exactly_ratio => std  => :exactly_ratio_std,
    :any_ratio => mean => :any_ratio_mean,
    :any_ratio => std  => :any_ratio_std,
    #:avg_agents_geq_per_task => mean => :avg_agents_mean,
    #:avg_agents_geq_per_task => std  => :avg_agents_std,
    nrow => :n_rows,   # how many samples contributed (often = #runs, if 1 row per run per time)
    :param_dir => (x -> length(unique(x))) => :n_runs
)
```

```{julia}
xcol = :interaction_rate
ycol = :dead_time
valcol = :unique_ratio_mean
#valcol = :unique_ratio_std
#valcol = :avg_agents_mean
#valcol = :avg_agents_std
#valcol = :any_ratio_mean
#valcol = :any_ratio_std

xs = sort(unique(agg[:, xcol]))
ys = sort(unique(agg[:, ycol]))
xi = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
yi = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(ys))

mat = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
for r in eachrow(agg)
    mat[xi[r[xcol]], yi[r[ycol]]] = r[valcol]
end
mat = mat'
```

```{julia}
title = "2b2t15c: $(string(valcol))"
heat_fig = Figure(resolution=(800,600))
labelsize = 32
ticklabelsize = 28
ax = Axis(heat_fig[1,1], 
            xlabel = L"\text{dead time } t_d", 
            ylabel = L"\text{interaction rate prefactor } \alpha",
            xlabelsize = labelsize,
            ylabelsize = labelsize,
            xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize,
            yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize)
            #title=title)
#ax = Axis(heat_fig[1,1], xlabel = "dead time r"$t_d$"", ylabel = "interaction rate r"$\alpha$"", title=title)

# draw on integer grid and keep the mapping via tick labels
# plot transposed matrix on x=1:length(xs), y=1:length(ys) so xticks->xs and yticks->ys
println("2dawg")
hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(xs), 1:length(ys), mat; colormap = :viridis)
println("dawg")
powers = 10.0 .^(-2:3)
powers = round.(powers, digits=5)
xtick_vals = intersect(xs, powers)
ytick_vals = intersect(ys, powers)
println("3dawg")
xtick_pos = [xi[v] for v in xtick_vals] 
ytick_pos = [yi[v] for v in ytick_vals] 
println("4dawg")
#ticks = [L"10^{-2}", L"10^{-1}", L"10^{0}", L"10^{1}", L"10^{2}", L"10^{3}"]
ax.xticks = (xtick_pos, string.(xtick_vals))
ax.yticks = (ytick_pos, string.(ytick_vals))
println("5dawg")
#ax.xticks = (xtick_pos, ticks)
#ax.yticks = (ytick_pos, ticks)
cb = Colorbar(heat_fig[1,2], 
        hm,
        #label = L"\text{Average of the highest Accuracies}", #IMPORTANT: check if it corresponds to the depicted value
        #label = L"\text{Average of the Coverage Fraction}",
        #label = L"\text{Standard deviation of the highest Accuracy}",
        #label = L"\text{Standard deviation of the Coverage Fraction}",
        label = "$(valcol)",
        labelsize = labelsize,
        ticklabelsize = ticklabelsize)
#cb.ticks = ([0.85, 0.90, 0.95], [L"0.85", L"0.90", L"0.95"]) #mean coverage
#cb.ticks = ([0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0], [L"0.6", L"0.7", L"0.8", L"0.9", L"1.0"]) #mean accuracy
#cb.ticks = ([0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], [L"0.0", L"0.1", L"0.2", L"0.3", L"0.4"]) #std accuracy
#cb.ticks = ([0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3], [L"0.0", L"0.1", L"0.2", L"0.3"]) #std coverage
```
